user_query: I'm planning a family vacation and I want to find kid-friendly destinations with attractions suitable for children of different ages. Can you suggest family-friendly hotels, amusement parks, and outdoor activities in each destination? Also, provide information about nearby hospitals and emergency services.

TaskList.description: Research and compile a list of kid-friendly destinations that have attractions for children of various ages.
For each destination, find family-friendly hotels that offer amenities suitable for families.
Identify and list amusement parks in each kid-friendly destination that cater to different age groups.
Find outdoor activities available in each kid-friendly destination suitable for various ages.
Gather information on nearby hospitals and emergency services for each destination to ensure family safety.
